meta.timerNote: EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 on ANGLE Metal returns non-zero, non-disjoint results that scale with GPU work, but they are spans of 2-2.5x the GPU-bound frame interval (e.g. Ultra downtown idle: query 8.4 ms at a 3.5 ms frame; one injected fullscreen pass: query 20.7 ms at an 8.1 ms frame), so not GPU busy time. gpuMs is null where the per-cell check fails (query median > 1.1x frame median); frameMs is the GPU-bound measure (trace.waitMsPerFrame shows the main thread waiting on the GPU side).
meta.parityNote: P.reset zeroes the renderer's _frame at each run's start, so recorded callback k renders with _frame = k + 1, and a preset that redraws its shadow map every 2nd frame (Low, facts.shadowEvery 2) draws it in callbacks k = 1, 3, 5, ... cpuParity indexes callbacks (cpu[k] is callback k): the shadow callbacks are the ODD ones. frameParity indexes intervals (frame[i] runs from callback i-1's rAF to callback i's, so it holds callback i-1's work): the shadow callbacks fall in the EVEN intervals; interval 0 holds a callback from before the reset and is left out. The GPU may finish a frame after its interval ends (frames in flight), so GPU cost can show an interval later: read the gap between the sides. Means over finite values; N is the count per side.
